## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and uses supported public entry points.
- [ ] Public types, defaults, events, slots, and CSS/token contracts are documented.
- [ ] Unit tests cover behavior and regressions.
- [ ] Keyboard and accessibility behavior is covered where relevant.
- [ ] SSR, RTL, density, theme, motion, responsive, and localization impacts were considered.
- [ ] Visual evidence and approved baselines are included for intentional visual changes.
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes when the change affects runtime behavior or rendering.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for consumer-visible changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated build output, or unrelated changes are included.
